Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Pendant with unnecessary white glove delivery fee](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a27296f170d727d54780c81)
I purchased a pendant light and white glove delivery got automatically added. The box was delivered to my lobby and there was no need for white glove delivery. Wished this was an option for certain item and not mandated on every purchase.

May 27, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 8, 2026

Hi Sab,

Thank you for reaching out to us! We understand your concern regarding the White Glove delivery fee applied to your pendant light order. Please note that White Glove delivery is a mandatory service for certain fragile or oversized items to ensure they are handled with the necessary care during transit. While we appreciate your feedback on this process, we are unable to waive or refund the shipping fee as it is part of our standard shipping method for this specific product.

We appreciate your understanding and are happy to help if you have any further questions!
